expected_level_description: You can: - show an awareness of Agile methodology and the ways to apply the principles in practice - take an open-minded approach - explain why iteration is important - iterate quickly
You can: - communicate relevant, compelling stories using the most appropriate medium - make complex recommendations at a tactical and strategic level

You can: - develop appropriate governance and assurance processes - identify and recommend improvements to governance and assurance processes - support others in following or applying governance and assurance processes

You can: - understand the environment and prioritise the most important or high value tasks - use data to inform planning - manage complex internal and external dependencies - provide delivery confidence - remove blockers or impediments that affect plans and can develop a plan for difficult situations - ensure that teams plan appropriately for their capacity

You can: - direct the stakeholder relationship strategy for your teams - ensure stakeholder's objectives are set and support teams to meet them - influence and negotiate with senior stakeholders to resolve issues and enable progress

You can: - define strategies and policies, providing guidance to others on working in the strategic context - evaluate current strategies to ensure business requirements are being met and exceeded where possible

You can: - analyse how a service fits into care pathways across organisations - work with clinicians, care staff, and patients to shape digital services - explain the effect of digital decisions on care, safety, and staff workload
You can: - take part in hazard workshops and contribute to a hazard log - follow the clinical risk management process for your work - provide evidence for a clinical safety case, such as test results

You can: - lead data protection impact assessments and information sharing agreements - advise teams on lawful basis, consent, confidentiality, and retention - investigate incidents and recommend improvements
You can: - manage large, complex, or high-risk projects - set project management standards and coach project managers - recover failing projects
You can: - design the organisation's risk management framework and appetite - advise the board on strategic risks
You can: - run the governance cycle for boards and committees - review policies and advise on compliance
You can: - line manage a team, setting objectives and running appraisals - support wellbeing and manage attendance, performance, and conduct - plan the team's development and succession
You can: - hold and manage a budget, forecasting and explaining variances - build a business case with costs and benefits
